ProposedCoverage.Finding: Reviewed 2026-10-02: Published post-print treatment/removal guidance is already recorded as Q00549. Its own wording is retained: Annealing temp. and time 120°C/16H. The source procedure and any specimen-preparation table are distinct; no guaranteed property improvement is inferred. The source recommends using the print without annealing when temperature resistance above 80°C is unnecessary. If annealed, avoid touching/loading the print, ensure uniform oven heating, retain support for bridges over 3 cm and specified overhang geometries, and consider ribs/increased wall thickness below 4 mm to limit deformation; keep the printing placement, preferably on its base plate. Colour may become lighter. Reviewed product: Polymaker Fiberon PET-GF15 (G068-02). Source basis: R-FIBERON-PETGF15-TDS. The other 3 active procurement products are outside this bounded material judgment; their individual passes remain separate.
